node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one quadratic HNF intersection
node.statement: Combining the quadratic pointwise equation g(1)=(1-rho*c)^3 with the h=7 residual conic eliminates r=rho*c into the fixed degree-fourteen polynomial R_2(d)=(a_0c_1-c_0a_1)^2-(a_0b_1-b_0a_1)(b_0c_1-c_0b_1), whose leading coefficient is -691200. Complete degree-two closure reduces to 32 norm-fiber gcds.
node.notes: Exact all-collision quadratic reduction only. The 32 norm-gcd verdicts are unrun because Modal is spend-blocked; higher color degrees and all outer/inner tests remain open.
